title: Ontario: Officials probe whether Taser gun caused death
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit is investigating whether a Taser stun gun was involved in the death of a 29-year-old boxer.
Jerry Knight died Saturday after a run-in with police at a Mississauga motel.
Police have not released the results of Mr. Knight's autopsy, which was performed yesterday and monitored by Taser company officials.

The use of Tasers has long been controversial, and the human rights group Amnesty International Canada yesterday called for police across the country to stop using the guns until a public and independent investigation into their risks is conducted.
Amnesty International Canada has linked Tasers to the deaths of two men in British Columbia in 2003.
